bias.label: Bounce stalls under 3,600; downtrend holds below 3,634

event: Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US stock and bond markets shut, thin trade. Fri 27 Nov: US half-day. Mon 30 Nov: COMEX December first notice day (UNVERIFIED). Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report (15:30 SAST, UNVERIFIED). Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, 21:00 SAST.

bullets.title: Holding the bounce
bullets.text: Gold traded near 3,571-3,578 on Thursday morning SAST after bouncing from below 3,450 on Wednesday (Mitrade; time of the ticker UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Stuck under 3,600
bullets.text: Headlines this morning say gold is testing 3,600 but struggling to get above it in light holiday trade (FXStreet, FX Leaders headlines only).

bullets.title: Yields eased
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield fell about 6 bp toward 4.84%, which helped Wednesday's recovery (Mitrade).

bullets.title: Hike still priced
bullets.text: Strong data (Q3 GDP 4.3%, core PCE 3.3%) keeps a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December at about 94-96% odds (CME FedWatch via Mitrade).

bullets.title: Dollar still firm
bullets.text: The dollar index held near 103.7-103.8 on Wednesday, close to its recent highs (FXEmpire, FinScans; not confirmed for today).

bullets.title: Still deep down
bullets.text: Gold is down about 12% in a month and near its lowest level in over a year, so the bigger trend is still down.

bullets.title: Thin holiday trade
bullets.text: With US markets shut today, moves can be jumpy and levels can break and snap back easily.

look: Price pushes up into 3,600-3,634 and stalls there.
